_comment: macOS: the input devices (keyboard, touch, pen, trackpad, motion) as on iPadOS -- NativeHidInput (build-droidvm-hid-input.py's staged ShengHidInput with the board's sinks) fed by the virtio-input transport -- linked by name against the collection's IOHIDFamily (no fixture: the macOS collection keeps its symbols); the linker checks the owned IOHIDDevice vtables against the family's. The touch screen is an absolute pointer and the app's mouse a mouse there (DroidVMPointerHid.inc): macOS makes no pointer of a digitizer. On crosvm's PCI host the virtio-input functions are this driver's too: DroidVMVirtioPCI (in the DroidVMGicMsi kext) holds them and the driver's start watches for them (DroidVMVirtioPciWatch.cpp), reaching each through the virtio-pci transport (DroidVMVirtioPci.c).
name: DroidVMInput
